features: Default-collapsed help and contextual task/rejection feedback
Live polarity selection preserving position, velocity, stars and learning
Real field ascent, neutral descent, negative-charge braking route
Stronger normal braking and safe checkpoint recovery
Optional challenges and persistent personal records

build.note: Builds existing enabled scenes with an opt-in development-only runtime probe. Only clone PlayerSettings are changed. Source assets, company/product identity, and visual resources are preserved.

routes.details: Natural collection and exit callbacks observed; unchanged saved physics and authored collision surfaces.
Natural collection and exit callbacks observed; unchanged saved physics and authored collision surfaces.

Natural collection and exit callbacks observed; unchanged saved physics and authored collision surfaces. Real negative-charge field ascent >=1 m, post-star neutral field descent >=1 m, and restored upward electric force >=0.1 s observed on the authored return route.
Natural collection and exit callbacks observed; unchanged saved physics and authored collision surfaces. Actual launch must be 50 V +/-0.01 V and both saved platforms must receive real top contacts.

assetPreservation.method: Read-only SHA256 comparison to Gameplay_BeforeHashes.json. Source files are never written. Scene reversals are in memory only. Visual YAML blocks are matched by original fileID and property name.
assetPreservation.allowedTypographyChange: Learning_Objective_Panel help-toggle label keeps its original font asset/material/colors; m_fontSize and m_fontSizeBase change 85 to 30 to display the Korean open/close label. Font resource preservation does not mean unchanged text size.
explicitBehaviorChanges: PlayerMovement no-input/opposite-direction braking deceleration: 3 to 9; jump/acceleration/mass/gravity/launch energy are preserved.
Stage04 existing field/plate width is expanded for the polarity traversal; force magnitude, voltage, vertical field extent and plate separation are preserved.
Functional checkpoint recovery, mandatory Stage04 traversal records, feedback/help UI and optional challenge persistence are intentional changes.
assetPreservation.auditLimit: Baseline covers the 391 files under the sung_wook game folder, not every unrelated asset in the Unity project. This is an asset/data preservation audit, not a replacement for runtime play verification.

limitations: Automated API-input routes with real physics/star/goal events, not a human playthrough.
Virtual InputSystem devices and explicit isolation fixtures verify input and negative cases separately from no-teleport routes.
Single Windows PC and short samples. No measured human enjoyment, learning outcome or long-run stability claim.
